L7: # Humanoid Cognitive Workload Balancing Dataset
L8: 
L9: This dataset models cognitive workload distribution
L10: across humanoid agents
L11: performing parallel and sequential tasks
L12: in decentralized environments.
L13: 
L14: It captures mental load indicators,
L15: task switching frequency,
L16: performance degradation signals,
L20: 
L21: To enable balanced cognitive task allocation
L22: and prevent overload-related performance decline
